name: DoveNetQ
summary: Brisbane ISP of the Uniting Church in Australia (national dialup, 71 POPs); rebranded ISPX ~2012, then Planet Ozi by 2018.

events.details: National dialup, broadband, hosting. Earliest Wayback capture 12 Dec 1998 (dovenetq.net.au).
Rebranded ISPX; dovenetq.net.au homepage last captured Feb 2012, then 302-redirecting from Apr 2013 and 301-redirecting from 2018 (Planet Ozi era).
